create_standardlayernorm_module: create a StandardLayerNorm module to apply layer normalization with optional bias and fp32 casting
create_rmsnorm_module: create an RMSNorm module to apply root mean square layer normalization to incoming data
reset_parameters_standardlayernorm: reset the StandardLayerNorm weight and bias parameters using default or custom init functions
normalize_tensor_rmsnorm: normalize a tensor using RMSNorm with elementwise affine weight and optional bias transformation
subclass_layernorm_abstract: subclass the abstract LayerNorm class to implement a custom forward normalization method
